title: pleione bulbocodioides
intro: Pleione bulbocodioides, commonly known as the Chinese orchid or the Pleione orchid, is a type of orchid plant species native to China. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, and its rhizome is believed to have health benefits such as reducing fever, alleviating coughs, and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Pleione bulbocodioides include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
